question: What is the curved surface area of a hemisphere whose radius is 21 cm?
solution:
**Given:**

Radius (r) = 21 cm

**Formula used:**

Curved Surface Area (C.S.A.) of a hemisphere = 2πr²

**Calculations:**

C.S.A. = 2 × (22/7) × (21)²

⇒ C.S.A. = 2 × (22/7) × 441

⇒ C.S.A. = (44/7) × 441

⇒ C.S.A. = 44 × 63

⇒ C.S.A. = 2772 cm²

**∴ The curved surface area of the hemisphere is 2772 cm².**
